chunks.text: The StarlingNet initial calibration reports a held-out sample size of 37 validation observations. This calibration achieved an F1 score of 87% on OrchardBench.
The inputs to StarlingNet were cropped to 224 x 224 pixels. Normalization was applied after cropping.
The StarlingNet external site evaluation reported balanced accuracy of 71%. This evaluation used an independent cohort at site R.
The StarlingNet replication calibration achieved an F1 score of 83% on OrchardBench. The cohort was disjoint from the initial calibration set.
CedarNet inference latency was 12 ms. The authors report memory usage only for evaluation, without reporting training hardware.
The StarlingNet initial calibration reports a held-out sample size of 99 observations in this separate demonstration. Its F1 score was 96%.
